title: CardCodeEntityMap
description: Standalone validation vehicle for PublicGame's CardCode-keyed entity/history maps (see contracts/schemas/public-game.schema.json#/$defs/cardCodeEntityMap). Real production key types whose ToJSONKey is `deriving newtype` from CardCode (Arkham/Id.hs unless noted): StoryId (stories), ScarletKeyId (scarletKeys, Arkham/Campaigns/TheScarletKeys/Key/Id.hs), and InvestigatorId (roundHistory/phaseHistory/turnHistory, Map InvestigatorId History in Arkham/Game/Base.hs). Entity value shapes remain an intentionally broad object placeholder -- out of scope for this map-key slice.
